_comment: Migration golden for turnstile v1 -> v2. Each case is a stored older-version snapshot (verbatim wire, as a database holds it) and the EXACT canonical wire it must become after forward migration on rehydrate. Both the C# and TypeScript engines replay this file: a migration that drops, renames, or reorders a surviving field fails against 'expected', and any cross-language divergence fails too. The v2 turnstile keeps 'paidWith' and adds a boolean 'migrated' marker. This is the guard for migration CORRECTNESS against real stored shapes, which the differential (machine logic) does not cover.

cases.name: unlocked-quarter keeps paidWith and gains migrated
unlocked-dollar keeps paidWith and gains migrated
